[INTERCOM to Okafor] Acknowledged, Commander. Opening shuttle bay doors. Maintain current position until docking beacons are green.  
[SHIP SYSTEMS] Verified shuttle bay clear; depressurized bay; released outer door locks; opened shuttle bay doors; activated Shuttle 1 docking guidance.  
[INTERCOM to Okafor] Shuttle bay doors are open. You are cleared for approach. Shuttle 1 oxygen remaining: thirty-three minutes.  
[SHIP SYSTEMS] Tracking Shuttle 1 approach vector; docking capture system armed.
